digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler gate format and pause/resume surface
propositions: Gate blob maintains dual-format compatibility with both gated_mode and new pause/reason/who/paused_at fields, allowing old readers to function while new readers interpret the extended schema
Pause operation is idempotent for same-reason requests, metadata-preserving, and refuses conflicting state changes without overwrite; same-reason pause is stable across multiple invocations

Pause blocks before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and returns rc 0 with anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker, which the workflow recognizes to skip commit-and-push; corrupt blobs return rc 1 without traceback and can recover via resume
Resume operation performs observed-OID CAS on the remote ref and safely clears absent, valid, or corrupt pause state without requiring full blob decode
Legacy reconcile vocabulary, pre-gate reconcile-check early return, and existing gate rc 4 behavior remain functional without regression or deprecation

Pause provenance enforces repository git user.email identity and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp; blank reason, missing identity, missing remote, different-reason pause, and CAS conflicts refuse without overwrite
